title: NOAHQA: Numerical Reasoning with Interpretable Graph Question Answering Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Manual examination and correction through a quantitative sampling mechanism, combined with employing a large, diverse pool of annotators to prevent the dataset from reflecting repetitive personal language styles.

Using predefined thresholds to restrict and monitor the proportions of different question types, ensuring annotators do not over-represent simple questions (e.g., extraction) over more difficult ones (e.g., numerical reasoning).

Examining dataset samples to ensure conversations do not follow a predictable, complete step-by-step reasoning path by artificially inserting 'Counterfactual', 'Comparison', and 'Unanswerable' question types.
